- YTXTube: the red opening screen is gone; the Pulse tab of Downloads has only a Series and movies button (it opens YTXTube's own page, not the Pulse app) and "All downloads" is removed.
- Keyboard clipboard: the pin icon is drawn on the diagonal; a stack of photos is the real picture turned a little each way, like a dropped pile, with no white sheets.
- YTXTube Downloads: the third tab is Series and movies (only the video files of the series and films you download), no Pulse tab, no All downloads button.
- Game Hub: Boxshelf's own 3D shelf (the web screen) is the default look again; the CD rack stays as a choice in Settings > Look.
- YTXTube channel page: a swipe sideways moves between Home, Videos, Shorts and Live.
- Keyboard symbols: a swipe sideways moves between the sub-categories of the family only (it no longer leaves for the next top category); signs the phone's fonts cannot draw are left out instead of showing as empty cells.
- Keyboard Dictionary: the meanings in the keyboard's language and in the other one come together, and the word kinds, languages and the Wikipedia name are in Turkish when the app is Turkish (noun → isim, Wikipedia → Vikipedi).
